The story

From one sewing machine
to the world

  1. The craft

    A name inside the camp

    Black Ntaw leads a fashion workshop inside Dzaleka, home to tens of thousands of people in central Malawi. Word spread through the camp, neighbours became clients, and a label was born, sewn one order at a time.

  2. The ceiling

    Talent, with nowhere to travel

    Movement restrictions mean the work cannot follow the demand for it. The market for Black Ntaw ends at the camp gate.

  3. The bridge

    Seeds of Tomorrow

    Seeds of Tomorrow builds the storefront, the logistics and the payments, so the product can leave even where its maker still cannot. A bridge, not a handout.
